verdict.rationale: Aider's core workflow is exactly this: add files (or let repo map find relevant ones), give a natural-language instruction via chat or --message, and it edits/commits changes across files; docs and community reports confirm it works well on existing multi-file codebases. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of multi-file accuracy, and community notes some quality/reliability caveats (subtle errors, retries) that keep it just short of flawless.
